comparison.objective: Candidate mechanically calibrates and locks a gripper stop; PR-2265 diagnoses which armoured-cable core leaks to earth.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses two concentric tools for rotational counterholding; PR-2265 simultaneously cranks a tester, seats a probe on three studs, reads the dial and selects a flag.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires locked angle retention through three cycles; PR-2265 requires all cores tested under sufficient crank speed, only the leaking core flagged, prod returned and released stillness. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous cranking and electrical probing tests sustained diagnostic tool use, not preservation of a threaded mechanical adjustment during locknut tightening.
